name: Browser Bridge
description: Ableton Live MIDI Remote Script (PushHackBrowser) that loads .adv/.adg presets onto the selected track via the Live browser API. push-manager / Shadow UI sends a preset id over a localhost socket (port 7704); the script calls browser.load_item() on Live's scheduler thread. Install copies the script into the User Library; enabling it in a free control-surface slot and restarting Live is a one-time manual step.
author: push-hack
